ValidationRule.description: The rule fires if the selected Contact is inactive OR not tied to the same Partner Account . JIRA SS-12685
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND(
NOT($Permission.DisableValidationRules), NOT(ISBLANK(Main_Point_of_Contact_3__c)), OR( TEXT(Main_Point_of_Contact_3__r.Status__c) = 'Inactive', Main_Point_of_Contact_3__r.AccountId <> Partner_Account__c ))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Main Point of Contact 3 must be Active and belong to the related Partner Account.
